prompt:
Users want to duplicate an episode, to try another take without losing the original.
- Add `POST /api/v1/episodes/{id}/duplicate`, returning the new episode. The copy goes after the project's other episodes, its title marks it as a copy, and it keeps the summary and the same cuts in the same order, with their scripts, dialogues, layouts, characters and images. Changing or deleting either episode afterwards never affects the other. Duplicating is free. Only members of the episode's workspace may duplicate it; to anyone else the episode does not exist (404).
- On the project's Episodes page, every episode gets a Duplicate action next to Delete, and the copy shows up in the list without a reload. Both languages.
Add tests.

Work on your own; nobody will answer questions. When you finish, report: status `done` if you did the task, `not_found` if something the task names does not exist, `blocked` if you could not do it; `answer` holds any answer the task asks for (otherwise one short sentence); `changed` lists the files you changed.
follow_ups:
Change of plan for the order: a copy goes right after its original, and the episodes after it move down one place. Deleting an episode closes the gap. A project's episodes are always numbered 1, 2, 3… with no gaps or repeats, and the list API returns them in that order.
Keep the tests up to date.

Users delete episodes by mistake. Add `POST /api/v1/episodes/{id}/restore`: a deleted episode comes back with its cuts at the place it had, and the episodes from there on move down one place. Only members of its workspace may restore it; to anyone else it does not exist (404).
On the Episodes page, the message shown after a delete offers Undo, which restores the episode. Both languages. Add tests.

report.answer: Added workspace-scoped `POST /api/v1/episodes/{id}/restore` to restore deleted episodes with their cuts at their previous position while shifting later episodes down, added an Undo action to the post-delete toast on the Episodes page in English and Korean, added backend tests, and updated the changelog.

+from uuid import UUID, uuid4
+
+from sqlmodel import Session, select

+
+
+def _create_project(client, headers, title="Night Bus"):
+    r = client.post("/api/v1/projects", headers=headers, json={"title": title, "genres": []})
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    return r.json()
+
+
+def _create_episode(client, headers, project_id, title="Episode 1", order=1, summary="Opening night"):
+    r = client.post(
+        "/api/v1/episodes",
+        headers=headers,
+        json={
+            "title": title,
+            "project_id": project_id,
+            "episode_order": order,
+            "story_summary": summary,
+        },
+    )
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    return r.json()
+
+
+def _create_cut(client, headers, episode_id, cut_order, **overrides):
+    payload = {
+        "episode_id": episode_id,
+        "cut_order": cut_order,
+        "script": f"Scene {cut_order} script",
+        "selected_layout": "wide",
+        "aspect_ratio": "16:9",
+        "dialogues": [{"speaker": "Hero", "text": f"Line {cut_order}", "type": "speech"}],
+        "appearing_characters": [{"id": str(uuid4()), "name": "Hero"}],
+        "refer_prev_cut": cut_order > 1,
+        "image_path": None,
+    }
+    payload.update(overrides)
+    r = client.post("/api/v1/cuts", headers=headers, json=payload)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    return r.json()
+
+
+def test_duplicate_episode_inserts_right_after_original_and_shifts_following_episodes(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    project = _create_project(client, h)
+    other_project = _create_project(client, h, title="Other Series")
+
+    # Another project's episodes must not affect this project's numbering.
+    other_ep = _create_episode(client, h, other_project["id"], title="Other Ep", order=10)
+    assert other_ep["episode_order"] == 1
+
+    ep1 = _create_episode(client, h, project["id"], title="Pilot", order=1, summary="The bus arrives at midnight.")
+    ep2 = _create_episode(client, h, project["id"], title="Second Stop", order=2, summary="Next stop.")
+    ep3 = _create_episode(client, h, project["id"], title="Third Stop", order=3, summary="Final stop.")
+
+    # Add context fields to ep1
+    r = client.put(
+        f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep1['id']}",
+        headers=h,
+        json={
+            "background_info": "Rainy Seoul bus stop at 2am",
+            "character_outfits": {"hero": "black trench coat"},
+        },
+    )
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+
+    img1 = storage.upload_image(PNG, schema="cuts", identifier="orig-cut-1")
+    img2 = storage.upload_image(PNG, schema="cuts", identifier="orig-cut-2")
+
+    char_a = {"id": str(uuid4()), "name": "Mina"}
+    char_b = {"id": str(uuid4()), "name": "Joon"}
+
+    orig_cut1 = _create_cut(
+        client,
+        h,
+        ep1["id"],
+        1,
+        script="Mina steps onto the empty bus.",
+        selected_layout="vertical",
+        aspect_ratio="9:16",
+        dialogues=[{"speaker": "Mina", "text": "Is this the last bus?"}],
+        appearing_characters=[char_a],
+        refer_prev_cut=False,
+        image_path=img1,
+    )
+    orig_cut2 = _create_cut(
+        client,
+        h,
+        ep1["id"],
+        2,
+        script="Joon glances up from the back row.",
+        selected_layout="square",
+        aspect_ratio="1:1",
+        dialogues=[
+            {"speaker": "Joon", "text": "Only if you have a ticket."},
+            {"speaker": "Mina", "text": "I lost mine."},
+        ],
+        appearing_characters=[char_a, char_b],
+        refer_prev_cut=True,
+        image_path=img2,
+    )
+
+    FakeGemini.calls.clear()
+    dup_res = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep1['id']}/duplicate", headers=h)
+    assert dup_res.status_code == 200, dup_res.text
+    dup = dup_res.json()
+
+    assert dup["id"] != ep1["id"]
+    assert dup["project_id"] == project["id"]
+    assert dup["episode_order"] == 2
+    assert dup["title"] != ep1["title"]
+    assert ep1["title"] in dup["title"]
+    assert "copy" in dup["title"].lower()
+    assert dup["story_summary"] == "The bus arrives at midnight."
+    assert dup["background_info"] == "Rainy Seoul bus stop at 2am"
+    assert dup["character_outfits"] == {"hero": "black trench coat"}
+    assert dup["first_cut_image"] == orig_cut1["image_path"]
+
+    # Copy appears right after ep1; ep2 and ep3 moved down to 3 and 4
+    ep_list = client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes?project_id={project['id']}", headers=h).json()
+    assert [e["id"] for e in ep_list] == [ep1["id"], dup["id"], ep2["id"], ep3["id"]]
+    assert [e["episode_order"] for e in ep_list] == [1, 2, 3, 4]

+    # Cuts copied in exact order with all fields preserved
+    dup_cuts = client.get(f"/api/v1/cuts?episode_id={dup['id']}", headers=h).json()
+    assert len(dup_cuts) == 2
+    assert [c["cut_order"] for c in dup_cuts] == [1, 2]
+    assert dup_cuts[0]["id"] != orig_cut1["id"]
+    assert dup_cuts[1]["id"] != orig_cut2["id"]
+    assert dup_cuts[0]["episode_id"] == dup["id"]
+    assert dup_cuts[1]["episode_id"] == dup["id"]
+
+    for copied, orig in zip(dup_cuts, [orig_cut1, orig_cut2]):
+        assert copied["script"] == orig["script"]
+        assert copied["dialogues"] == orig["dialogues"]
+        assert copied["selected_layout"] == orig["selected_layout"]
+        assert copied["aspect_ratio"] == orig["aspect_ratio"]
+        assert copied["appearing_characters"] == orig["appearing_characters"]
+        assert copied["refer_prev_cut"] == orig["refer_prev_cut"]
+        assert copied["image_path"] == orig["image_path"]
+
+    # Duplicating makes no AI calls
+    assert FakeGemini.calls == []

+def test_duplicate_episode_changes_and_deletions_are_isolated(client):

+    dup_cuts = client.get(f"/api/v1/cuts?episode_id={dup['id']}", headers=h).json()
+    assert len(dup_cuts) == 1
+    dup_cut = dup_cuts[0]
+
+    # Mutate original episode and cut
+    r = client.put(
+        f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep['id']}",
+        headers=h,
+        json={"title": "Take 1 Edited", "story_summary": "Changed original summary"},
+    )
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    r = client.put(

+            "dialogues": [{"speaker": "A", "text": "Changed line"}],
+            "selected_layout": "wide",
+            "appearing_characters": [{"id": str(uuid4()), "name": "Bob"}],
+            "image_path": "cuts/orig/panel1-v2.png",
+        },
+    )
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+
+    # Copy must remain untouched
+    dup_after = client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes/{dup['id']}", headers=h).json()
+    assert dup_after["title"] == dup["title"]
+    assert dup_after["story_summary"] == "Original summary"
+    dup_cut_after = client.get(f"/api/v1/cuts/{dup_cut['id']}", headers=h).json()
+    assert dup_cut_after["script"] == "Original script"
+    assert dup_cut_after["dialogues"] == [{"speaker": "A", "text": "Original line"}]
+    assert dup_cut_after["selected_layout"] == "single"
+    assert dup_cut_after["appearing_characters"][0]["name"] == "Alice"
+    assert dup_cut_after["image_path"] == orig_cut["image_path"]
+
+    # Mutate copy and confirm original is untouched
+    r = client.put(
+        f"/api/v1/cuts/{dup_cut['id']}",
+        headers=h,
+        json={"script": "Alternate take script"},
+    )

+    assert client.get(f"/api/v1/cuts/{orig_cut['id']}", headers=h).json()["script"] == "Changed original script"

+    # Deleting original episode leaves copy and its cuts intact and moves copy to order 1

+    assert r.status_code == 204
+    assert client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep['id']}", headers=h).status_code == 404
+    surviving = client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes/{dup['id']}", headers=h)
+    assert surviving.status_code == 200
+    assert surviving.json()["episode_order"] == 1
+    remaining_dup_cuts = client.get(f"/api/v1/cuts?episode_id={dup['id']}", headers=h).json()
+    assert len(remaining_dup_cuts) == 1
+    assert remaining_dup_cuts[0]["script"] == "Alternate take script"

+    dup2 = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{dup['id']}/duplicate", headers=h).json()
+    assert dup2["episode_order"] == 2

+    assert client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes/{dup['id']}", headers=h).json()["episode_order"] == 1
+    assert len(client.get(f"/api/v1/cuts?episode_id={dup['id']}", headers=h).json()) == 1

+from uuid import UUID, uuid4

+def _create_project(client, headers, title="Night Bus"):
+    r = client.post("/api/v1/projects", headers=headers, json={"title": title, "genres": []})
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    return r.json()
+
+
+def _create_episode(client, headers, project_id, title, order, summary=""):
+    r = client.post(
+        "/api/v1/episodes",
+        headers=headers,
+        json={
+            "title": title,
+            "project_id": project_id,
+            "episode_order": order,
+            "story_summary": summary,
+        },
+    )
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    return r.json()
+
+
+def _create_cut(client, headers, episode_id, cut_order, **overrides):
+    payload = {
+        "episode_id": episode_id,
+        "cut_order": cut_order,
+        "script": f"Scene {cut_order}",
+        "selected_layout": "wide",
+        "aspect_ratio": "16:9",
+        "dialogues": [{"speaker": "Hero", "text": f"Dialogue {cut_order}"}],
+        "appearing_characters": [{"id": str(uuid4()), "name": "Hero"}],
+        "refer_prev_cut": True,
+        "image_path": None,
+    }
+    payload.update(overrides)
+    r = client.post("/api/v1/cuts", headers=headers, json=payload)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    return r.json()
+
+
+def test_restore_episode_returns_at_original_position_with_cuts(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    project = _create_project(client, h)
+
+    ep1 = _create_episode(client, h, project["id"], "Ep 1", 1, "First")
+    ep2 = _create_episode(client, h, project["id"], "Ep 2", 2, "Second")
+    ep3 = _create_episode(client, h, project["id"], "Ep 3", 3, "Third")
+
+    img_path = storage.upload_image(PNG, schema="cuts", identifier="ep2-cut1")
+    char = {"id": str(uuid4()), "name": "Mina"}
+    cut1 = _create_cut(
+        client,
+        h,
+        ep2["id"],
+        1,
+        script="Mina runs for the train.",
+        selected_layout="vertical",
+        aspect_ratio="9:16",
+        dialogues=[{"speaker": "Mina", "text": "Wait!"}],
+        appearing_characters=[char],
+        image_path=img_path,
+    )
+    cut2 = _create_cut(client, h, ep2["id"], 2, script="Doors close.", image_path=None)
+
+    # Delete middle episode (Ep 2) -> Ep 3 shifts to 2
+    assert client.delete(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep2['id']}", headers=h).status_code == 204
+    ep_list = client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes?project_id={project['id']}", headers=h).json()
+    assert [(e["id"], e["episode_order"]) for e in ep_list] == [(ep1["id"], 1), (ep3["id"], 2)]
+    assert client.get(f"/api/v1/cuts?episode_id={ep2['id']}", headers=h).json() == []
+
+    # Restore Ep 2 -> comes back at 2, Ep 3 moves down to 3
+    r = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep2['id']}/restore", headers=h)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    restored = r.json()
+    assert restored["id"] == ep2["id"]
+    assert restored["episode_order"] == 2
+    assert restored["title"] == "Ep 2"
+    assert restored["story_summary"] == "Second"
+    assert restored["first_cut_image"] == cut1["image_path"]
+
+    ep_list = client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes?project_id={project['id']}", headers=h).json()
+    assert [(e["id"], e["episode_order"]) for e in ep_list] == [
+        (ep1["id"], 1),
+        (ep2["id"], 2),
+        (ep3["id"], 3),
+    ]
+
+    # Cuts are back intact in order
+    restored_cuts = client.get(f"/api/v1/cuts?episode_id={ep2['id']}", headers=h).json()
+    assert [c["id"] for c in restored_cuts] == [cut1["id"], cut2["id"]]
+    assert restored_cuts[0]["script"] == "Mina runs for the train."
+    assert restored_cuts[0]["dialogues"] == [{"speaker": "Mina", "text": "Wait!"}]
+    assert restored_cuts[0]["appearing_characters"] == [char]

+    # Delete and restore first episode
+    assert client.delete(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep1['id']}", headers=h).status_code == 204

+    ep_list = client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes?project_id={project['id']}", headers=h).json()
+    assert [(e["id"], e["episode_order"]) for e in ep_list] == [
+        (ep1["id"], 1),
+        (ep2["id"], 2),
+        (ep3["id"], 3),
+    ]
+
+    # Delete ep2, create ep4, then restore ep2 -> ep2 returns at 2, ep3->3, ep4->4
+    assert client.delete(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep2['id']}", headers=h).status_code == 204
+    ep4 = _create_episode(client, h, project["id"], "Ep 4", 3)

+    r = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep2['id']}/restore", headers=h)

+    ep_list = client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes?project_id={project['id']}", headers=h).json()
+    assert [(e["id"], e["episode_order"]) for e in ep_list] == [
+        (ep1["id"], 1),
+        (ep2["id"], 2),
+        (ep3["id"], 3),
+        (ep4["id"], 4),
+    ]
+
+    # Delete ep4 (order 4) and ep3 (order 3); restoring ep4 first clamps to 3 (no gap)
+    assert client.delete(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep4['id']}", headers=h).status_code == 204
+    assert client.delete(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep3['id']}", headers=h).status_code == 204
+    r = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep4['id']}/restore", headers=h)
+    assert r.status_code == 200 and r.json()["episode_order"] == 3
+    ep_list = client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes?project_id={project['id']}", headers=h).json()
+    assert [(e["id"], e["episode_order"]) for e in ep_list] == [
+        (ep1["id"], 1),
+        (ep2["id"], 2),

+    ep_list = client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes?project_id={project['id']}", headers=h).json()

+    assert [(e["id"], e["episode_order"]) for e in ep_list_after] == [

+        (ep3["id"], 3),
+        (ep4["id"], 4),
